P0-D01_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.findings: Document precedence established against authoritative PDFs; unavailable historical documents are not falsely represented as directly reviewed.

P0-D02_REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.findings: Exactly 25 functional requirements mapped to source basis, phase ownership, and verification criteria with zero duplicates or missing items.

P0-D03_ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.findings: All 10 ADRs audited and mutually consistent. PostgreSQL is the canonical transactional SoR for E-7-owned operational state. Flowable remains authoritative for its native workflow-runtime execution state; E-7 stores only the canonical references, mappings, business-facing records, audit/evidence, and other E-7-owned state assigned by the ownership model. External systems retain authority over their native master data.

fet_evaluation.status: Isolated benchmark wrapper only; mandatory legal review before any distribution; rejected as primary production solver due to AGPL-3.0 viral copyleft risks

P0-D04_LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.findings: Comprehensive license review verified. Flowable OSS (Apache 2.0 runtime), OR-Tools (Apache 2.0 solver), UniTime (LGPL-3.0 decoupled service), FET (AGPL-3.0 benchmark only, legal review required, rejected as foundation), n8n and Camunda 8 Zeebe formally rejected.

P0-D05_REFERENCE_USE_CASES.findings: Both reference use cases exist and are confirmed as test/reference benchmarks only, not contractual production commitments.

P0-D06_FIXTURE_DATASETS.findings: All 18 logical fixture datasets were reconciled against tests/fixtures/MANIFEST.json using their exact dataset IDs and declared repository paths, and all declared files were verified present. 100% synthetic data, zero PII, zero credentials.

P0-D07_HISTORICAL_VERIFICATION.findings: Repository evidence records the prior fixture-corpus audit result (642 passed, 0 errors, 0 blockers in docs/poc/PHASE_0_FIXTURE_CORPUS_AUDIT.md). Task 0I.1/0I.1A/0I.1B/0I.1C did not rerun all 642 historical checks.

P0-D08_INTEGRATION_BASELINE.findings: First ERP source (mysql_iredu) contracted; runtime adapter intentionally NOT_IMPLEMENTED in Phase 0. Live retrieval gated by BLK-01 (authoritative organization / tenant scoping is unresolved for live MySQL production context retrieval) and BLK-02 (authoritative academic physical-resource model / authority is unresolved for resource/scheduling production use). E-8 contract and mock resolved. External provider decisions D-EXT-01 (Google Cloud Identity / Google Workspace) and D-EXT-02 (Google Calendar under Google Workspace, bidirectional) are formally resolved via project-authorized provider selections.

P0-D09_SLO_RETENTION_SCALE_EVIDENCE.findings: SOURCE_NUMERIC_TARGET = 0 confirmed. RTO/RPO ungrounded in available sources. First-tenant scale profile requires business confirmation.

P0-D10_CANDIDATE_BASELINE.findings: All targets classified as engineering proposals. Zero targets promoted to contractual SLAs or approved baselines. Exact p95 < 500 ms inequality preserved; fallback-only retention precedence enforced.

P0-D11_SECURITY_PRIVACY.findings: Bounded repository scan found 0 credential exposures. Tenant/organization scope must be derived from authenticated and authorized principal/service credentials according to approved authentication mechanisms (OIDC/JWT + API key) and not trusted from arbitrary request input. Strict aggregate-only context boundary enforced for AI.

P0-D12_OBSERVABILITY_NFR.findings: Observable telemetry candidate metrics fully defined across API, Task Intelligence, Workflow, Scheduling, Event Broker, Database, and Integrations.

P0-D13_PHASE_1_DESIGN_READINESS.findings: Engineering design is completely specified and ready to implement upon Phase-0 gate clearance. No frozen runtime/application/dependency/ADR/fixture/source artifact was modified.

core_invariants: PostgreSQL is the canonical transactional SoR for E-7-owned operational state. External systems (ERP/SIS, external calendars, IdPs) retain exclusive authority over native master records, calendar states, and identity assertions; external IDs remain mappings only
LLMs restricted to non-authoritative planning/drafting subject to deterministic validation

Mathematical constraint solvers (OR-Tools / UniTime) for scheduling
Adapter isolation shielding domain from external SDKs and IDs

findings.title: Decision D-EXT-01: Confirm Exact Production Identity Provider (IdP) [RESOLVED]
findings.description: Confirm the exact production Identity Provider used by the organization/customer environment. Resolved: Google Cloud Identity / Google Workspace managed organizational identity selected via project-authorized provider selection. Google ID tokens are signed JWT identity assertions; OAuth access tokens are bearer credentials for Google APIs; audience matches approved OAuth client ID(s); hd != canonical E-7 tenant_id; service API key remains frozen initial service-auth baseline.

findings.title: Decision D-EXT-02: Confirm First Production Calendar System/Provider [RESOLVED]
findings.description: Confirm the first production calendar system/provider that E-7 must integrate with. Resolved: Google Calendar under Google Workspace selected with BIDIRECTIONAL integration direction via project-authorized provider selection. CALENDAR_AUTHORIZATION_TOPOLOGY = TO_BE_CONFIRMED_DURING_IMPLEMENTATION; UTC_SAFE_TIME_HANDLING; E-7 owns idempotency; nextSyncToken lifecycle with HTTP 410 full re-sync; HTTPS callbacks with channel-token verification.

findings.title: Task 0H.2 Candidate SLOs are Unbenchmarked

findings.title: BLK-01: Authoritative Organization / Tenant Scoping is Unresolved for Live MySQL Production Context Retrieval
findings.description: Upstream MySQL database (iredu) lacks tenant partitioning; live production context retrieval is blocked until business confirmation defines the exact tenant partitioning predicate. Authoritative organization / tenant scoping is unresolved for live MySQL production context retrieval. Narrow impact: does not block generic E-7 operational functions, internal PostgreSQL execution, or synthetic testing.

findings.title: BLK-02: Authoritative Academic Physical-Resource Model / Authority is Unresolved for Resource/Scheduling Production Use
findings.description: Upstream MySQL schema does not establish an authoritative academic room/resource model with required properties (capacity, type, equipment). Authoritative academic physical-resource model / authority is unresolved for resource/scheduling production use. Gates production physical-resource scheduling where authoritative room data is required. Narrow impact: does not block generic Task Intelligence planning, curricular timelines, or staff role assignment. Does not automatically imply UniTime or student cohort mapping.
